atoms.name: Bayes rule and MAP decision
atoms.one_line: Predict $\arg\max_y P(y)P(x\mid y)$; the evidence $P(x)$ cancels.

atoms.name: Conditional independence
atoms.one_line: $P(x\mid y)=\prod_jP(x_j\mid y)$, features independent given the class only.

atoms.name: Estimating priors and likelihoods from counts
atoms.one_line: Prior $=n_y/n$; likelihood $=n_{v,y}/n_y$, always within the class.

atoms.name: Laplace smoothing
atoms.one_line: $\hat P(v\mid y)=(n_{v,y}+\alpha)/(n_y+\alpha V)$ removes zero counts.

atoms.name: Gaussian naive Bayes
atoms.one_line: Each (class, feature) has a mean and variance; shared variance gives a linear boundary.

atoms.name: Generative model and error probability
atoms.one_line: Fits $P(x,y)$; conditional error at $x$ is $\min_yP(y\mid x)$.
